title: Yokai: Lust Secret 🪭
description:
Yokai: Lust Secret is an adult visual novel set in an Asian folklore-inspired world, where mystery, everyday life, and temptation blend into one immersive story. 🔞

Your normal life can fall apart in an instant… especially when reality starts acting up.

Lately, something feels off. Strange coincidences, unsettling vibes, weird visions… and people around you seem to be hiding more than they should. And then there’s her — a mysterious girl who keeps showing up where she definitely doesn’t belong.

The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to tell what’s real… and what’s not.

What starts as just another ordinary day at the office quickly turns into something far more disturbing — a chain of events where logic breaks down, and desire and fear start to blur together.

👁 Someone is watching you
👘 Something is messing with your mind
💋 And someone clearly wants to get… way too close

Every step pulls you deeper into a world where myths might be real — and temptation might be a trap.

Will you figure out what’s going on… before it’s too late?✨ Features:
👘 atmospheric Asian folklore & urban mystery vibes
🧩 puzzles and interactive mini-games
💋 seductive yokai girls with unique personalities
📖 choice-driven story with multiple outcomes
🔞 adult content (18+)
🎮 play at your own pace — even one-handed 😉
description_short: Yokai: Lust Secret is an adult visual novel set in a mysterious Asian folklore world. Strange events, eerie encounters, and seductive yokai blur the line between reality and illusion. Uncover the truth before you’re pulled too deep. 🔞
